raw_response: BNY Mellon described strong growth in its ETF servicing business throughout 2024, noting that ETF Assets Under Custody and Administration (AUC/A) reached $2.8 trillion by the fourth quarter of 2024, representing an increase of over 60% year-over-year. Inflows into ETFs on their platform continued to outpace the market. Earlier in the year, during the third quarter of 2024, ETF AUC/A was reported at $2.7 trillion, up more than 70% year-on-year, with inflows remaining strong across all asset classes and the number of funds serviced increasing by 20%. The company attributed this performance to multiyear investments in these platforms and highlighted particular strength in ETF servicing as a key driver of growth.
